UPSTREAM: util/abuild: Set exit status on failure Currently, the what-jenkins-does target doesn't stop if abuild fails. This change gives a command line parameter to abuild with tells it to exit with a non-zero exit status if any of the builds failed. This will be particularly useful for concourse which doesn't parse the junit.xml files, and only knows whether a build passed or failed by the exit status.
